summary: Revised plan clarifying and implementing true background wheel spinning: WheelCanvas remains continuously mounted and running in the background across all slides (using CSS opacity/z-index instead of conditional DOM destruction). If the presenter spins from Slide 0 and switches to Slide 1 mid-spin, the wheel is seen actively rotating in real-time at the exact elapsed point, with 100% slide independence (TV never auto-switches slides on spin).
